page.layout: One printed page, a title page, centred: Hebrew title lines at top, then Latin title lines, an engraving with a motto below the picture, the imprint and date at the foot. No margins with text.

main_text.l: S. Theol. D. Ejusd. ut & Ling. Orient.

page.notes: Handwritten "2" at top left is not printed text and is omitted. The engraving shows a pelican-like bird on a nest with young, with a motto of letters below it (R X L M M, partly illegible); the motto letters are not transcribed. Hebrew title is transcribed as read; its exact letters are approximate.
